images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: OFF SHFT ecommerce main product preview. Image 1 is the edit target. Image 2 is supporting style reference for its warm Bone seamless backdrop ONLY; do not copy its hat. Normalize Image 1 to a square studio product photograph on warm Bone #ECE5D3 matte seamless background with very soft short contact shadow, matching Image 2 backdrop. Subject: Ivory crewneck front; exact "5:00" dark navy numerals and rusty orange colon. Preserve EXACT product silhouette, proportions, fabric colour, weave, wrinkles, seams, collar/hood/brim, artwork glyphs/colour/size/placement and view from Image 1. Change only background/lighting; no horizon, sunbeams, foliage shadows, props, labels or extra text. Fit the entire original product centered within square canvas, keep at least 5 percent clear space on every side. Do not crop any sleeve, cuff, hem, hood or brim. Do not redesign or stylize garment/artwork. Output one polished square product image.

checks: Full product visible, no cropped sleeves, cuffs, hem, hood or brim.
Correct front/back view, garment/cap colour, wording, line layout and accent thread/print colours retained.
Warm seamless Bone-family backdrop; no horizon, sunlight bands, props or white border.
Square framing and soft contact shadow.
